map.由每期现金流与贴现率求永续年金现值: Perpetuity Present Value from Periodic Cash Flow and Discount Rate
map.输入每期现金流 C 与贴现率 r，求永续年金现值。: Enter periodic cash flow C and discount rate r to find the perpetuity present value.
map.📖 查看「由每期现金流与贴现率求永续年金现值 使用指南」: View "Perpetuity Present Value from Periodic Cash Flow and Discount Rate User Guide"
map.PV=C÷r，C 每期现金流、r 贴现率，适用于永久国债、优先股等无限期现金流。: PV = C ÷ r, with C the periodic cash flow and r the discount rate, suited to consols, preferred stock and other infinite cash flows. In reality most carry call or default clauses; a strict perpetuity exists only in models.
map.优先股、永久债券等无限期现金流估值。: Value infinite cash flows such as preferred stock and consols.
map.用股息贴现模型估计股票内在价值。: Estimate a stock's intrinsic value with the dividend-discount model.
map.每年 100、贴现率 5% 的永续现值: Perpetuity present value at 100 per year, discount rate 5%
map.PV=C÷r=100÷0.05=2,000 元。这是该永续现金流在当前利率下的理: PV = C ÷ r = 100 ÷ 0.05 = 2,000 yuan. This is the theoretical price of that perpetual cash flow at the current rate.
map.近似存在：英国 Consols 永久国债、优先股固定股息、某些年金产品。严格无限: Approximately: UK Consols, preferred-stock fixed dividends and some annuity products. A strict infinite term holds in models; in reality most carry call/default clauses.
map.增长率不为 0 时怎么办？: What if the growth rate is not zero?
map.用增长永续年金 PV=C÷(r−g)，要求 r>g。这是优先股/股息模型中「永续: Use the growing perpetuity PV = C ÷ (r − g), requiring r > g. This extends the 'perpetuity + growth' in preferred-stock/dividend models.
